edgeCaseHunter.coverage: Focused hosting cutover; baseline diff includes prerequisite work.

individualTriage.finding: R3B1: release README still asks for NUGET_API_KEY
individualTriage.evidence: carried B2: the same README claim is unchanged and the independent trusted-publishing migration remains its cause. Retain the existing follow-up without duplicate deferral.

individualTriage.finding: R3B2: active recovery description names removed projection discovery
individualTriage.evidence: The guide describes pending/parking discovery and projection-based cascade decisions, while WorksProcessSourceCatalog discovers retained RuntimeQueueKey members and reminder/process adapters read authoritative streams. Correct this active operational description for the cutover.

individualTriage.finding: R3B3: non-HTTP absolute Parties URI passes validation
individualTriage.evidence: The absolute-only rule accepts unsupported schemes. The same Uri.TryCreate validation and typed-client assignment exist in pre-cutover 6967819 WorksHost.cs; moving registration did not introduce this configuration defect. HttpClient.BaseAddress itself checks absolute form, as confirmed in the .NET 10 source.

individualTriage.finding: R3B4: custom gateway has two independently configured identities
individualTriage.evidence: Works ingress/policy uses Works:Query:GatewayWorkloadId, while producer 3.126.0 DomainQueryDispatcher uses Authentication:QueryAuthority:GatewayWorkloadId for caller authority. Setting only the former can deny a custom caller. Pre-cutover WorksHost, unchanged options/policy and the already-selected SDK have the same split.

individualTriage.finding: R3B5: full-family fold latency at admitted limits is unproved
individualTriage.route: defer, carried; unverified medium; no new entry
individualTriage.evidence: carried B10: the same family-wide FoldCatchUpAsync reads remain, without a measured real-store budget failure. The existing benchmark follow-up remains sufficient; do not defer again.

individualTriage.finding: R3B6: noncooperative identity resolutions can accumulate
individualTriage.evidence: carried R2B9: WorksQueryPolicy is unchanged and the same deadline test demonstrates unfinished provider work. Retain the existing bounded-concurrency follow-up without another entry.

individualTriage.finding: R3B7: query failures lose their exception diagnostic
individualTriage.evidence: Both handlers discard read/deserialization exceptions before returning projection-unavailable, obscuring the cause for operators. These exact catch behaviors exist in pre-cutover 6967819; removing unreachable legacy branches did not introduce the SDK behavior.

individualTriage.finding: R3B8: tenant discovery failures lose their diagnostic
individualTriage.evidence: WorksProcessSourceCatalog catches tenant errors and returns incomplete discovery without recording the cause. The entire file is byte-identical to pre-cutover 6967819, sha256 5e5aa4f97c6105b154929bcf621c7212446e83c4c90f2e49271cf7f743f9d5a2.

individualTriage.finding: R3B9: unpaged queue may exceed invocation limits
individualTriage.evidence: Paging is unused and the authorized queue is returned, identically to the pre-cutover SDK path. No actual response/deadline-limit failure is shown. Settle with real invocations at admitted queue and serialized-byte limits before choosing a paging contract.

individualTriage.finding: R3B10: static Parties bearer has no in-process rotation path
individualTriage.evidence: The typed client captures IOptions.Value into its bearer header, so external configuration changes do not refresh running authority. The same pattern exists in pre-cutover 6967819 WorksHost.cs. Document the restart boundary or separately specify/test refresh behavior.

individualTriage.finding: R3P1: new public graph regression lacks required XML documentation
individualTriage.evidence: The new public P0_SolutionReferencesKeepOneGlobalPropertySetPerWorksProject method lacks the XML summary and parameter documentation required by the baseline. A direct documentation correction changes no executable behavior.
